newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: OAU summit ends in Zimbabwe.
newsitem.headline: OAU summit ends in Zimbabwe.

text.p: The Organisation of African Unity ended a three-day summit on Wednesday, pledging support for efforts to restore democratic rule in Sierra Leone.

"We unanimously agreed on the setback to democracy...and we call for the restoration of the constiutionally elected government," Zimbabwe President Robert Mugabe, the new OAU chairman, said in closing remarks.

The meeting was attended by about 30 heads of state or government, U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan and James Jonah, Sierra Leone's U.N. ambassador. Jonah represented President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah who was ousted in a coup staged by junior military officers on May 25.
President Laurent Kabila of the Democratic Republic of Congo, formerly Zaire, was also at the summit where political developments in Africa's Great Lakes region were discussed at length.
